intro: About 280 kcal for 1 bowl of bubur kacang hijau. The calories come from mung beans, sugar and santan.
diet: Yes, bubur kacang hijau has a plus point because mung beans give protein and fibre. What pushes the calories up is the sugar and santan. A small bowl for tea time is a good fit. If you eat a big bowl, count it as a meal, not a snack.
tips: Choose a small bowl at the stall or bazaar.
If cooking at home, cut down the sugar and use thinner santan.
Have it as a tea-time snack, don't add it after dinner.

swap.name: Bubur kacang hijau without santan, less sugar
swap.why: You still get the protein and fibre from mung beans, with less fat and sugar.

faq.q: Do mung beans need soaking first?
faq.a: Soaking 2-3 hours helps them soften faster. If you don't have time, just boil them longer.

faq.q: Can bubur kacang hijau be eaten cold?
faq.a: Yes. Many people like it cold from the fridge, especially in hot weather.

faq.q: How long does bubur kacang hijau keep?
faq.a: About 2-3 days in the fridge. Santan spoils fast, so don't leave it out at room temperature for long.
